item.title: [PARQUET-1311] Update README.md
item.description:
parquet-mr documentation is not up to date:

  • points to broken URLs
  • tells to install old Thrift version (while it uses newer)
  • current version is 1.8.1, but 1.10.0 is already released

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.
